$:set -eu
echo '=== REPOSITORY DOCUMENTS ==='
test -f AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,26p' AGENTS.md
echo '=== WORKFLOW REGISTERED ==='
gh workflow view codespace-mcp-expression-inventory.yml --repo BestNameYet/Terminals
echo '=== WORKFLOW YAML CONTENT CHECK ==='
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
p=Path('.github/workflows/codespace-mcp-expression-inventory.yml')
data=yaml.safe_load(p.read_text())
assert len(data['jobs'])==1
j=data['jobs']['extract-expressions']
assert any('npm ci' in str(x.get('run','')) for x in j['steps'])
assert any('collect-expressions.js' in str(x.get('run','')) for x in j['steps'])
assert any('upload-artifact' in str(x.get('uses','')) for x in j['steps'])
print('yaml_parse=ok, job_steps=',len(j['steps']))
PY
echo '=== SCRIPT ==='
node --check workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/collect-expressions.js
echo '=== PACKAGE ==='
node -e "const p=require('./workspaces/codespace-mcp-srs-design/expression-inventory/package.json'); console.log(Object.keys(p.devDependencies))"
